issues.description: Method name inconsistency: the exercise describes a static method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal): int (UML and text), but the code artifacts use a different name. The template Main calls shop.computeMealCost(Meal) (template repository), the solution's SealSaloon defines public static int computeMealCost(Meal) (solution repository), and the commented example in the solution Main calls shop.calculateTotalPrice(Meal). This mismatch between calculateTotalPrice and computeMealCost across problem statement, template, and solution is confusing: students cannot tell which exact method name and signature to implement, and example code may not compile or match the required API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name and signature consistent across all artifacts. Preferred option: follow the problem statement/UML and rename computeMealCost to the specified static method: public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal) in SealSaloon, update all example calls in Main and the template to call calculateTotalPrice (or call SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(meal) to emphasize static usage). Alternatively, if computeMealCost is preferred, update the problem statement and UML to reference computeMealCost(Meal): int. Ensure the template, solution, and examples all use the same identifier and signature.

issues.description: The exercise describes and shows in the UML a static method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal) (problem statement: calculateTotalPrice), but the code uses a different identifier for the same concept: the SealSaloon class in the solution implements a static method named computeMealCost(Meal), and the template/Main code calls computeMealCost in the template but the solution's Main calls calculateTotalPrice. Concretely: the problem statement expects calculateTotalPrice(Meal); the solution SealSaloon defines computeMealCost(Meal); the template Main calls computeMealCost(...); the solution Main (commented example) calls calculateTotalPrice(...). This inconsistent naming for the single concept “compute total price/cost of a Meal using the shared stock” will confuse students (they will search for calculateTotalPrice and not find it, or implement calculateTotalPrice while solution code expects computeMealCost).
issues.suggestedFix: Pick a single identifier for the operation and apply it consistently across all artifacts. Preferred fix: rename the static method in SealSaloon from computeMealCost(Meal) to calculateTotalPrice(Meal) and update all call sites (Main.java in template and solution) and the UML/problem text to use calculateTotalPrice. Ensure the signature is static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal) (as required by the problem) and update any tests or documentation accordingly. Alternatively, if you prefer computeMealCost, update the problem statement/UML to refer to computeMealCost and document that name consistently.
